attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine 3.23), replaced busybox's crond (which has no user allow/deny mechanism) with cronie, created the opsadmin user, populated /etc/cron.allow with only root and opsadmin, removed any /etc/cron.deny, and enabled/started the cronie crond service. Verified root and opsadmin can manage crontabs while an arbitrary third user is denied. Root's original periodic crontab (15min/hourly/daily/weekly/monthly run-parts) was preserved. Completed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a pre-restart boot_id and healthy baseline, rebooted node1, polled until it came back, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified cron.allow enforcement, the crond service, and root's crontab content all survived the restart.
